action.content: WITH top_categories AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT ref_id, cat_nm FROM taxn_g1 WHERE cat_lvl = 1), spanning AS (SELECT f.uid FROM top_categories t JOIN fdbk_g1 f ON f.ref_id = t.ref_id WHERE f.uid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.uid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.cat_nm) >= 2) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spanning) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uid) FROM fdbk_g1), 2) AS percentage;
